answer: Sybil resistance can be priced, not hoped for. Require every identity to lock a slashable bond at a unique work vertex in the attestation graph; the coins stay frozen until a multi-epoch settlement horizon of independently checked, non-duplicative work is complete. Early exit, cloned answers, or recycled keys slash the stake. The fable that one operator can mint a cheap crowd then fails: each extra name demands fresh capital and a long wait before rewards vest, so attacker cost scales with identities, not scripts.
